seo.title: Book a discovery call | Yordan Ivanov
seo.description: Book a free 30-minute discovery call with Yordan Ivanov about priorities, stakeholders or your promotion case. No pitch, no commitment.

sections.title: Tell me what you're stuck on
sections.subtitle: The discovery call is 30 minutes and free. Bring the fourth urgent request you can't say no to, the promotion case you're drafting or the data roadmap nobody above you reads, and I'll tell you whether I can help. Pick a slot below, or email me for anything else.

sections.title: Pick a slot
sections.description: No pitch and no commitment. If I can help, I'll tell you how and share my rates on the call, so pick a slot.
